The Particle (EA-RECEPTION-PARTICLE-01) is a reception-layer measurement

atoms.reference: An empirical reception-layer measurement: twenty simulated blind reviews of eleven configurations of a note on SE 183b34-36 did not vary with the object; every round inserted a qualifier into the sentence, and the terminal compliant round endorsed Aristotle's sentence with one particle, ou, removed. The four frames (provenance erasure, machine-mediated reception, disciplinary model collapse as the author's own term, the world soul as degraded commodity as a theoretical extension) are marked as interpretations of that result. Limit: the run does not establish that Socrates belongs inside the chapter's 'we', only that every tested route for excluding him required a premise the passage does not supply.
